params.title: College Student
params.rig: MPFB game_engine (Unreal-style bone names: root, pelvis, spine_01-03, neck_01, head, clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand, thigh/calf/foot/ball, fingers)

renderer.college_hair: recommended: material.alphaToCoverage = true with an MSAA render target (softens the alpha-tested card edges); keep alphaTest 0.35 as the fallback without MSAA

licenses.textures: CC0-1.0 inputs (MakeHuman, Poly Haven) baked here

params.rootMotion: clips play in place; move the character along +Z at meta.clips.<clip>.rootMotion.speedMps to keep planted feet still
params.clips: loop (THREE.LoopRepeat): idle, walk, run, work, use, eat, sit, attack, sleep; oneShot (THREE.LoopOnce with clampWhenFinished): pickup, hit, death. Every clip starts at the origin facing +Z, feet (or body) on y = 0; none travels except death, which falls backward and ends lying on the back along the clip's Z axis (head toward -Z, face up, pelvis near the origin; meta.clips.death.pose.end). sleep lies the same way (on the back, head toward -Z, face up, the lowest body point on y = 0, pelvis over the origin): lay it on the mattress top with the head toward the pillow. sit is seated with the underside of the buttocks at meta.clips.sit.pose.seatHeightM above the floor, the pelvis over the origin and the feet on the floor ahead of it: put the origin on the floor under the middle of the seat, not on the cushion. meta.clips.<clip>.pose has the pelvis height range, the lowest body point and each end frame's head direction and pelvis position (glTF axes).
params.locomotion: playback rate of the moving clip = sim speed / its rootMotion.speedMps, clamped to meta.locomotion.rateClamp; crossfade meta.locomotion.crossfadeSec to and from idle (also in the glb's root extras)

texelDensity.unit: texels per metre (atlas mean; every island packed at the recipe density, ART.md §3 hero class)

attack.use: a two-handed forward strike (zombies at doors and at the survivor)
attack.title: Chopping wood: a two-handed overhead strike, forward and down

death.use: collapse to the ground and lie still (once; hold the last frame)
death.title: Rug-pull fall: collapses backward onto the back, then lies still

eat.title: Eating a sandwich: standing, both hands to the mouth

hit.title: Stand still, with a procedural backward flinch layered on

flinch.envelope: smoothstep rise to peakSec, smoothstep settle to the end

idle.title: Stand still (then a casual walk forward)

pickup.use: bend down and pick something up (once)
pickup.title: Picking a box up, bending the knees

sit.use: seated idle on a chair or sofa, in front of the TV
sit.title: Sit on a stepstool: seated idle, hands in the lap

sleep.title: Lying on the back before getting up (held), with procedural breathing

use.use: standing work at a counter or bench: cooking, crafting, washing
use.title: Making dough: standing, hands at counter height

work.use: bent-over work in place with the hands at waist-to-knee height: repairing, rummaging, farming
work.title: Planting a tree: bent over, both hands working low
